skill.name: segment-automation
skill.description: Automate Segment customer data workflows through Rube MCP, including tracking, identity, groups, pages, aliases, and batch operations.
skill.summary: Guide Segment event, identity, group, page, alias, and batch workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameter names, and example fences. I found no actual shell execution, prompt injection, or system reconnaissance instructions. The Rube MCP URL is a low-severity external service dependency because it changes the trust boundary for Segment data.

remediation.suggestion: Clearly disclose that Segment operations depend on the Rube MCP endpoint and require user-authorized account access.
Add stronger guidance to minimize traits, context fields, and identifiers before sending data to Segment destinations.
Require explicit human confirmation before using source update tools because they can affect data collection behavior.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Segment connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `segment`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `timestamp`: ISO 8601 timestamp (optional; defaults to server time)
- `context`: Object with contextual metadata (IP, user agent, etc.)
- At least one of `userId` or `anonymousId` is required
- `event` name is required and should follow consistent naming conventions
- `traits`: Object with user properties (email, name, plan, etc.)
- At least one of `userId` or `anonymousId` is required
- To remove a trait, set it to `null`
1. `SEGMENT_BATCH` - Send multiple Segment calls in one request [Required]
- `batch`: Array of message objects, each with:
- Each message in the batch must have a valid `type` field
- `traits`: Object with group properties (name, industry, size, plan)
- `groupId` is required; it identifies the company or organization
- `properties`: Object with page-specific properties (url, title, referrer)
- At least one of `userId` or `anonymousId` is required
- `name` and `category` are optional but recommended for proper analytics
- `previousId` is the anonymous/old ID, `userId` is the new/identified ID
- Always include `userId` or `anonymousId` on every call
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Avoid sending PII in traits unless destinations are configured for it
- Each message in the batch must have a valid `type` field
- Avoid sending sensitive PII unless destinations are configured for it

content.value_statement: Segment tracking work requires precise schemas and identity rules. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for events, users, groups, pages, aliases, and batches.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for Rube MCP and active Segment connection checks.
Directs users to search current tool schemas before Segment actions.
Covers track, identify, group, page, alias, and source workflows.
Explains batch message structure for multiple Segment call types.
Provides guidance for naming, timestamps, identity fields, and response parsing.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Segment connection.
Does not verify delivery to downstream Segment destinations.
Does not replace privacy, consent, or schema governance reviews.
Source updates can affect data collection and need human review.

use_cases.title: Instrument Product Events
use_cases.description: Send consistent track calls for key user actions after confirming the current Segment tool schema.

use_cases.title: Maintain User Profiles
use_cases.description: Identify users, update traits, and connect users to organizations with clear identity requirements.

use_cases.title: Import Historical Activity
use_cases.description: Prepare batch calls with timestamps and message types for efficient backfills into Segment.

prompt_templates.title: Check Segment Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup check before using the skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm Rube MCP is available, search for current Segment tool schemas, and tell me whether my Segment connection is active.

prompt_templates.title: Track One Event
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the current Segment schema to prepare a track call for a signed-in user event. Include required fields and note any missing values.

prompt_templates.title: Update Identity And Group
prompt_templates.scenario: Connect a user profile to an organization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify this user with approved traits, then associate the user with a group. Validate identifiers before sending either call.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Batch Backfill
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Segment batch operation for historical events, identifies, pages, and aliases. Check schema limits and list validation risks first.

output_examples.input: Track an Order Completed event for a known user.
output_examples.output: The skill searches the current Segment schema, confirms required identity and event fields, and prepares a track call with approved properties.

output_examples.input: Import a week of signup and page events.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a batch workflow, checks each message type, includes historical timestamps, and flags missing identifiers before submission.
The skill explains the one-way alias step, then suggests identify and track calls using the new user identifier.

best_practices: Search current Rube MCP tool schemas before each workflow.
Use stable event names, trait names, and property names across sources.
Review privacy rules before sending traits, context, or identifiers.
anti_patterns: Do not send Segment calls without a userId or anonymousId.
Do not alias the same identity pair repeatedly.
Do not update source configuration without reviewing collection impact.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Segment connection?
faq.answer: Yes. Rube MCP must be connected, and the Segment toolkit connection must be active.

faq.question: Can it send batch events?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes Segment batch workflows for track, identify, group, page, and alias messages.

faq.question: Does it manage downstream destinations?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Segment calls and source settings, not destination configuration.

faq.question: How does it handle tool schemas?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to search Rube MCP tools first so current schemas are used.

faq.question: Can it help with identity resolution?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains userId, anonymousId, identify, group, and alias usage patterns.

faq.question: Should I send personal data through it?
faq.answer: Only send approved data. Confirm consent, destination settings, and company privacy rules first.
